# Meet Transfer – LLMs.txt
# https://meettransfer.app
# Last updated: 2026-02-07

> Meet Transfer is Turkey's leading private airport transfer and chauffeur service. We provide fixed-price, professional door-to-door transfers across Turkey and Dubai with licensed drivers and luxury Mercedes vehicles.

## Core Services

- [Airport Transfer Service](https://meettransfer.app/services): Private airport transfers in Istanbul, Antalya, Bodrum, Izmir, Cappadocia, Ankara, Bursa, Dubai and 81 Turkish cities
- [Instant Vehicle Service](https://meettransfer.app/blog/instant-vehicle-service-guide): Book a vehicle and get it at your door in 20 minutes with fixed pricing
- [Intercity Transfer](https://meettransfer.app/blog/intercity-transfer-turkey): City-to-city private transfers across Turkey
- [Hourly Chauffeur Service](https://meettransfer.app/luxury-chauffeur): Hire a professional driver with luxury vehicle by the hour
- [VIP Transfer](https://meettransfer.app/blog/vip-airport-transfer-turkey): Premium Mercedes Maybach and VIP Vito with starlight ceiling

## Key Features

- **Fixed Pricing**: No meters, no surge pricing. The price you see is the price you pay.
- **25% Round-Trip Discount**: Add a return transfer and save 25% automatically.
- **Instant Driver Info**: Get driver name, phone, vehicle plate, and photo immediately after booking.
- **Vehicle at Door in 20 Minutes**: Fast response time for instant bookings.
- **11 Languages Supported**: EN, TR, DE, FR, RU, IT, ES, AR, UK, JA, PT
- **4.7★ Google Rating**: 50,000+ satisfied customers

## Fleet

- **Economy Sedan**: 1-3 passengers, from €25
- **Mercedes Vito**: 1-6 passengers, from €40
- **VIP Mercedes Vito**: 1-6 passengers, starlight ceiling, from €60
- **Mercedes Maybach**: 1-3 passengers, ultra-premium, from €120

## Booking

- [Book Online](https://meettransfer.app/book): Instant price quote and booking
- [WhatsApp Booking](https://meettransfer.app/whatsapp-booking): Book via WhatsApp with AI assistant
- Phone: +90 850 307 74 46
- Email: info@meettransfer.com

## Popular Routes

- Istanbul Airport (IST) → Taksim, Sultanahmet, Kadıköy, Beşiktaş
- Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW) → Asian Side, Kadıköy, Pendik
- Antalya Airport → Belek, Side, Kemer, Lara, Alanya
- Bodrum Milas Airport → Bodrum, Turgutreis, Yalıkavak
- Izmir Airport → Çeşme, Kuşadası, Selçuk
- Dalaman Airport → Fethiye, Marmaris, Ölüdeniz
- Cappadocia (Kayseri/Nevşehir) → Göreme, Ürgüp, Avanos
